_doc: gpt-oss-20B, OFFICIAL openai checkpoint (MXFP4 weights), TP=2.
MXFP4 runs on Hopper: mxfp4.py has an is_sm90_supported() branch. NVFP4
does NOT -- modelopt_quant.py raises 'Please use Blackwell and above' -- so
an NVFP4 build of this model cannot be benchmarked on this node at all.
Hybrid SWA: 24 layers alternate sliding_attention / full_attention, so only
the 12 full-attention layers get a mixed-KV quant pool. capacity.py's
prediction assumes a uniform full-attention pool and is therefore an UPPER
BOUND here; B_max is taken from the server's logged max_total_num_tokens,
ABSORB_V_ROT=0: the weight-folding helper walks contiguous global layers and
cannot handle the hybrid layer pattern.
QUANT_GROUP_SIZE=0: head_dim=64 -> one scale group per head.

MoE backend pinned to 'triton': the image's triton_kernels has no .routing module (API moved), so the auto-selected TRITON_KERNEL path dies with NameError: name 'routing' is not defined at topk.py:331.

Prefill backend is triton, NOT fa3: fa3 dies on this model's hybrid-SWA attention path with 'Boolean value of Tensor with more than one value is ambiguous' (hybrid_attn_backend.py:189 -> flash_attention_v3.py:131). The Qwen configs keep fa3, which works there.
